text: I feel curious and contemplative, moving between two different modes of engagement. In the first scene, watching through glass as others focus on a lecture or workshop, I feel an outsider’s longing; the quiet buzz of concentration invites reflection about learning as a communal act. In the second, the bold "R+D" and illuminated displays stimulate my mind. Here, innovation and creative thought are celebrated visually—I feel inspired by this vibrant environment, where research and development become a form of collective discovery. The juxtaposition of introspective observation and lively exhibition stirs both admiration and anticipation within me.
